findings.consequence: The STOREWAIT → PUBLISH loop depicts a retry of both local publication and NAS upload. The implementation retries only the failed action: an upload failure retries nas.upload_video without calling DownloadFiles.publish again.
findings.smallest_correction: Separate local publication and NAS upload in the flow, or label the retry loop so it unambiguously returns to the failed action alone.

evidence: src/uav_downloader/daemon/task_manager.py:997-1009 invokes the retry helper separately for local publication and NAS upload.
src/uav_downloader/daemon/download_files.py:58-94 and src/uav_downloader/daemon/nas.py:252-301 implement the distinct publication actions.
tests/test_daemon_downloads.py:1348-1470 describes download and publication retry behavior; tests/test_nas.py:571-593 describes recovery after a partial NAS upload.
The comparison base has no download.execute flow; this candidate introduces its baseline.
limitations: This was a read-only review; application code and tests were not executed, and no test execution evidence was supplied.
The flow intentionally excludes subtitle-only tasks, site extraction internals, and restart recovery.
